note: Use a trend's format and joke inside the story. Life-rule lessons only from Ep 16. Do not put copyrighted songs in the video file.

fits.trend: Black Friday / TikTok Shop deals (#tiktokshopblackfriday, #tiktokgoblackfriday rising)
fits.use: Clyde buys 'deals' he doesn't need (a 3-for-1 on umbrellas in dry season). Life rule: a discount on something you don't need is still spending. Use late Nov.
Zim December: everyone home, aunties asking questions, spending everything, then broke January. Rules about saying no to family pressure and planning for January. Use from early Dec.
Make one frame per episode screenshot-worthy: a reaction face plus a short line people can repost as a meme.
